race.title: Gamble Responsibly At BetMGM Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: QUAVISTE 's promising run in the Morebattle at Kelso on his final outing of last season suggests it's surely only a matter of time before he's winning over hurdles. Limier d'Arthel shaped nicely on his handicap debut/reappearance at Worcester recently and is second choice ahead of ready Sedgefield maiden winner Mia Sunshine . QUAVISTE (FR) LIMIER D'ARTHEL (FR) MIA SUNSHINE (GER)
